Standard Flats: Largest category of BTO supply, may come with 1-2 good locational attributes like near to MRT stations or good amenities
Plus Flats: Choicer locations (e.g. nearer to city centre, good connectivity, good amenities, and/ or with unique features like waterfront living)
Prime Flats: Choicest locations (e.g. centrally located, excellent connectivity, and comprehensive amenities and/ or with unique features like waterfront living)

Plus Flats: More subsidies, in addition to significant market discounts
Prime Flats: Most subsidies, in addition to significant market discounts

Standard Flats: Standard This includes: 5-year MOP Renting out of whole flat allowed after MOP No subsidy recovery upon resale of flat
Plus Flats: Tighter This includes: 10-year MOP No rental of whole flat Subsidy recovery upon resale of flat (less than Prime)
Prime Flats: Tightest This includes: 10-year MOP No rental of whole flat Subsidy recovery upon resale of flat
